text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, there are so many different kinds of radiance
in the world of Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: However, I truly believe. The strongest and most noble brilliance belongs to the Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Would you care to join me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Would you help me
spread this radiance together?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much~
Let's get going then~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright. You're not alone today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
We promised, didn't we?
That we'd make the Mejiro name shine together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Dober, that is true.
Today you also~..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I want to run for the Mejiros.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to lead the Mejiros. Ahead of Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Dober... That resolve of yours is truly magnificent.
Well then, let us be on our way."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
In order to meet—
many splendid splendors beyond the Mejiro name.
This year's Arima Kinen boasts one of the most star-studded lineups in history.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Grass-chan, El-chan,
King-chan, Sei-chan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Let's blow away Miss Bright and all the fans
with our wicked-fast running!"

text_block_list.name: Grass & El
text_block_list.text:
No way...
Bueno—!!

text_block_list.name: King & Sky
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Totally~

—The "Golden Generation."
A spirited new wave of Umamusume charging into a new era.

An Umamusume's power is indeed passed down.
However, it is not through a family name.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It is, strictly speaking—a secret technique passed down only from mother to daughter.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I shall display the majestic glory inherited from my mother right here.
Air Groove proudly presents a lineage distinctly apart from the Mejiros. And...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The present has arrived!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Bright-san, your Christmas present is me!
Let me add some flair to your big stage!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well, "luck" is the ultimate superpower,
so she just might win after all! ☆

"Matikanefukukitaru, who can overturn everything—
speed, pedigree, and all—with pure 'luck.'"

Truly a free-for-all brawl of racing culture.
Even so, the one who will win is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
In every era, the Mejiros have been admired by all.
And that is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I shall prove that we remain ever unchanged.
Please watch over me, dear sisters of generations past.
